intersections.note: Victory (printed VICTORY ... BLVD.) meets Gilbert where Gilbert turns from NE-SW to E-W; a stub of the same width continues north of Gilbert to the plate edge (unnamed on this plate). Gilbert's north side is close to the plate's top edge here

acute Y: Dixmont (printed DIXMONT AV., drawn as a tab beyond the plate's top edge, centre y~375) leaves Gilbert's north side eastward; point is where the two centrelines meet, uncertain ~30 px along Gilbert
Durrell begins at Gilbert; Gilbert's north line is the plate edge here
Merrimac starts at Durrell and runs east
Victory curves south and merges into Durrell; south of here Durrell is 100 ft wide (Victory's roadway forms its west half). Same junction as Euretta, ~30 px west
Euretta runs SE from Durrell. Spaced letters E-U-R-E-T-T-A are printed NW of the junction across the City of Cincinnati land (unopened extension), not drawn as a street
Gilpin starts at Durrell (100 ft section) and runs east
Durrell narrows from 100 ft (north) to 60 ft (south) at Lincoln
Ashland starts at Lincoln and runs south; name from ASHLAND printed further south (only AVE. printed on this block)
Whitlow (printed WHITLOW ... ST., name at x~2900) ends at Ashland from the west
Chapel name printed west of the strip (CHAPEL at x~1700) and STREET at x~5000
Durrell ends at Chapel
Ashland ends at Myrtle; Myrtle angles WNW west of Ashland
Burdett ends at Woodburn from the west

street east of Woodburn printed TAFT (at x~6100); suffix uncertain (a lone ST. is printed at x~9000). South side cut by the plate edge; centre assumed ~35 px below north line. House numbers (1500+) continue Locust's (1354), so it may be Locust's eastern continuation renamed; offset ~140 px along Woodburn from Locust
Locust ends at Woodburn from the west
street shown only as a tab beyond the plate's east edge, label truncated 'LOC...'; runs east from Woodburn
north arm of the U-shaped Crescent Place loop
south arm of the U-shaped Crescent Place loop
Bell Place starts at Locust and runs south
McMillan printed only ST. here; south side of McMillan cut by the plate's bottom edge, centre y uncertain ~15 px
Woodburn ends at McMillan; McMillan continues east in a tab past the plate edge; centre y uncertain ~15 px

bends.note: Durrell widens to 100 ft and its centreline shifts ~40 px west at the Victory/Euretta junction

ends.note: plate edge: stub north of Gilbert

notes: Strip c: x 3640-4970 plus ~300 px overlap (3340-5270). Victory is printed VICTORY (x~3400, y~950) and BLVD. (x~4400, y~1950) on the same curved road; recorded as Victory Boulevard. Durrell is 60 ft from Gilbert to the Victory/Euretta junction, 100 ft from there to Lincoln, 60 ft from Lincoln to its end at Chapel; the whole plate is turned ~3.5 deg so Durrell, Ashland and Bell Place lean (x drifts ~-0.03 to -0.06 per px of y) and E-W streets slope down to the east. The narrow strip at y~4450-4560 between Ashland and Woodburn is numbered lots 87/88 (with a building), not an alley. Spaced letters THOS. WILLIAMS EST., PROTESTANT CEMETERY, CITY OF CINCINNATI, ASHBURN'S EST. etc. are owner labels, not streets. A N-S street (60 ft, centre x~3243) meets Myrtle west of the overlap; Harvard (printed HARVA..., x~5340) meets Merrimac just east of the overlap; neither picked. Taft: printed TAFT; suffix not seen in this strip. Gilbert between Victory and Dixmont: a wedge between the plate's top edge and Gilbert's north line (which carries a 6-inch water pipe label further east) is not drawn as a separate street; Gilbert's centre taken between that north line and the lot line on its south side.
